hero.title: Frontend Engineer

intro.name: Yuxin Zhang
intro.text: a Software Engineer working across AI/ML and full-stack, based in China with six months of industry experience, specializing in data visualization and low-code platform development.
intro.textZh: 一位专注于 AI/ML 与全栈开发的软件工程师，现居中国，拥有六个月的工业经验，专注于数据可视化与低代码平台开发。

hero.body: I love using frontend technologies to solve real-world problems. I've worked on AI-powered platforms and internal digital tools that streamline decision-making and boost productivity. My main interests lie in building intuitive, high-performance data visualization tools and low-code platforms that drive digital transformation.
hero.bodyZh: 我热爱用前端技术解决现实问题。我曾参与构建 AI 驱动平台及内部数字化工具，以提升组织效率与决策能力。我对高性能数据可视化工具和低代码平台尤为感兴趣，致力于推动数字化转型。
